explication: Apollo is a centralized configuration-management system. Administrators manage applications, clusters, namespaces, and key/value items through the Portal; changes are published as versioned releases, then configuration clients can receive updates in real time. The tree and excerpts support the Portal search and business-service responsibilities, release/namespace handling, audit, and config-service notification/synchronization areas. Several server subsystems are represented at their exact tree paths but were not sampled, so their internal calls are not asserted.
